exposure: exposure to damp spots in the home
laying on a woollen blanket in the first year of life
passage of trucks in front of the house
use of coal or kerosene or cow dung as a cooking fuel
cohort: The study included 20084 children, 25887 adolescents, and 81296 adults from 9 sites across India.
finding: The study identified various genetic, environmental, personal health, and dietary risk factors for asthma/current wheeze in Indian children, adolescents, and adults.
mod_finding: Caesarean birth was associated with current wheeze in adolescents (AOR 1.28, CI 1.07-1.53).
